You see I'm looking to go fully off-grid for my house since here theyre doing a purposeful controlled demolition of the power grid in order to transition the local economy to UBI based off of CBDCs. nba_directive.reason_text: This client is already engaged and ready to move on a refi — the play is to remove friction and advance directly to application, not re-sell or interrogate them with discovery questions.
nba_directive.recommended_strategy_text:
- Reply immediately and directly to what they asked — no generic opener, no re-pitch
  - Acknowledge their current situation in one line: 6.75% rate, $2,092/mo P&I on a $307,013 balance
  - Answer their specific question first, then move forward

- Advance straight to the next step — skip the consultative layer
  - Tell them you can pull a no-obligation soft credit check right now to show them real numbers
  - Send the e-sign/soft pull link in the same message — one tap, no phone call required
  - Frame it as: 'Takes 2 minutes, won't affect your credit, and I can show you exactly what your new payment would be'

- Keep the message short and action-forward
  - One sentence of context, one sentence on the soft pull, one link — done
  - Do NOT ask multiple discovery questions or re-explain the value of refinancing
  - Do NOT make up a new rate or savings figure — let the soft pull results drive that conversation
